body:
Please add a source-qualified native MS adapter and condition mapping for **PXD017154 / PMID33025005**, DOI **10.1182/blood.2020008464**: *Permissive HLA-DPB1 mismatches in HCT depend on immunopeptidome divergence and editing by HLA-DM*.

This is a concrete missing source for Presto's MHC-II condition-aware training, not the DP/K562 source in #856 or DO:DM titration in #860. Searches of current Hitlist `43e2266` curation and existing issue titles/bodies found no accession/PMID owner.

Primary evidence:

- [ProteomeXchange](https://proteomecentral.proteomexchange.org/cgi/GetDataset?ID=PXD017154) explicitly describes HeLa HLA-DP repertoires with/without HLA-DM.
- [PRIDE project metadata](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pride/ws/archive/v2/projects/PXD017154) links the Blood DOI, declares CC0, describes B7/21 capture, variable methionine oxidation, and distinguishes identification exports, quantitative processing and PLAtEAU-derived cores.
- The [public archive](https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2022/11/PXD017154/) contains processed mzTab/mzIdentML files as well as raw spectra. The first API page alone includes ten result files; this is not a complete-file count.
- The community-annotated SDRF has **32 acquisitions / 11 source-name labels**, with DPB1*04:02 and *10:01 both DM-present/DM-not-coexpressed, DPB1*04:01 DM-present, and a no-DP control. It reports two biological-replicate labels and up to three technical-replicate labels. These are community assertions needing primary-source verification, not established independent specimen counts.
- The SDRF only names DP beta alleles; **DPA identity remains unresolved** in this reviewed metadata. Do not infer an alpha chain from the common beta type.

Acceptance:

1. Recover original publication/supplement mapping of each processed file to exact alpha/beta construct, DM/CD74/DO condition, cell clone, biological preparation, acquisition and technical replicate. Preserve community versus primary annotation provenance. Do not convert “not coexpressed” into a measured zero protein concentration or knockout.
2. Retain original PSM/peptide identities, modifications/sites, confidence/FDR, parent alternatives, run-level values and missingness. Keep reported identification, MS1 quantity, normalized/imputed core abundance and predicted binding distinct.
3. Preserve no-DP capture-control observations in their control namespace; do not relabel them as positive pMHC ligands or affinity negatives. Unobserved peptides are not measured nonbinders.
4. Expose concurrent source-qualified conditions through the common evidence schema, with explicit unknowns and within-source comparison membership. Verify processed-file/sample joins and exact molecular identity before training admission.
5. Reconcile overlap with IEDB/CEDAR and existing supplements rather than counting repeated public rows as independent data.

Presto audit: `experiments/2026-11-10_1431_codex_ms-condition-contrasts/`, related pirl-unc/presto#155. PRIDE JSON SHA256 `9c3c95d42d2d1067087fd60a504c956f84e54653cf7c343e65ae7ec8200c3da3`; SDRF SHA256 `410e3eee8c7afe0cabcac61680907ccf02ea45edf8597e611e87525ed700c7ce`. No raw spectra or new model predictions were downloaded/generated for this source discovery.
title: Qualify paired HLA-DP / HLA-DM immunopeptidomes from PXD017154 (PMID33025005)
